verses.1: And Naomi said to her, “My daughter, I will not ask you for anything. I’ll find you a peaceful place where you can rest.”
verses.2: And now, O Belz, we know that you were one of his young women. Now, he has cut off the branches of those trees at night.
verses.3: And you shall wash yourself and put on your clothes. Then you shall go down into the valley. Do not know any man until he has eaten and drunk until he is full.
verses.4: And when he was lying down, you would know the place where he would lie. Then you would come and lay down beside him. He would tell you what you should do.
verses.5: And she said to her, “All that you say to me, I will do.”
verses.6: And the oven was brought down, and everything that she had ordered was done.
verses.7: And Boaz ate, and he was satisfied. His heart was glad, and he went to lie down at the end of the field. Then she entered the tent, uncovered her feet, and lay down.
verses.8: And at midnight, the man became frightened. He woke up, and there was a woman lying beneath his feet.
verses.9: And he said, “Who are you?” She replied, “I am your true love. You have spread your wings over your true love, for you will save her.”
verses.10: And Boocha said, “You are the daughter of Jehovah. Your kindness is greater than your wealth. I will not follow those who are chosen, whether they are poor or rich.”
verses.11: And now, my daughter, do not be afraid of everything I say. I will do it, because he knows every single door in my people’s land. He knows that I am the one who will bring destruction upon them.
verses.12: And now, indeed, since I am saved, there must also be someone who is saved from me.
verses.13: May I rest tonight. And if you are to be saved, then good will come to you. But if not, then I, the Lord, will save you. I will keep you safe until morning.
verses.14: And he lay down with his legs spread apart until morning. Then he got up before anyone could recognize his wife. He said, “Let no one know that the old woman has arrived.”
verses.15: And the woman who was holding the mitpachah on her said, “Let me hold it.” She held it tightly. Then six doors appeared, and she entered through them. The city was opened for her.
verses.16: And she went to her mother and said, “Who are you, my daughter?” Then she told her everything that the man had done to her.
verses.17: And Shekhinah said to me, “These six gates have been given to me because she said to me, ‘Do not enter them; they are evil places.’”
verses.18: And Shebhi said, “My daughter, wait until you know how things will turn out. For the man won’t be able to keep his secrets anymore, if all of this happens today.”
